releaseNotes:
NextGenSoftware.OASIS.API.Providers.COSMOSBlockChainOASIS v2.0.5

Connects the OASIS to the Cosmos ecosystem -- the Internet of Blockchains. Uses Cosmos SDK and IBC to store OASIS holons and avatars across any connected chain (Cosmos Hub, Osmosis, Celestia, and 100+ others). Part of the OASIS HOT-Swappable Provider Architecture. Ecosystem: https://oasisomniverse.one
